Alien Worlds is a decentralized metaverse built on the Ethereum, WAX, and Binance Smart Chain blockchains. It provides an expansive platform that offers users a unique and captivating virtual space. At the heart of this metaverse is its native currency called Trilium (TLM), which serves as a powerful incentive for explorers to engage in various games and activities within the ecosystem.

One of the key features of Alien Worlds is its governance model, which actively involves users in decision-making processes. To participate in governance, users must stake Trilium tokens, granting them the ability to influence the future of the metaverse.

Users have numerous opportunities to interact with the metaverse. They can mine resources, acquire and lease land, vote on proposals regarding planet management, and influence the distribution of Trilium and non-fungible token
rewards. As the metaverse evolves, planets will offer their own unique games and NFTs, expanding the range of strategic actions available to explorers.
